build_mask_rcnn_c4_model: build a Mask R-CNN C4 model config using Detectron2 GeneralizedRCNN with ResNet-50 backbone
configure_resnet_backbone: configure a ResNet-50 backbone with FrozenBN normalization and res4 output features
configure_rpn_proposal_generator: configure an RPN proposal generator with 15 anchors and NMS threshold 0.7
configure_res5_roi_heads: configure Res5 ROI heads for 80 classes with ROIAlignV2 pooling and mask head
configure_box_predictor: configure FastRCNN output layers with box2box transform weights 10,10,5,5 for detection
